title: A Novel Interpretability Metric for Explaining Bias in Language Models: Applications on Multilingual Models from Southeast Asia

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluation using the gender subsection of the CrowS-Pairs benchmark by comparing model probability scores for stereotypical versus less stereotypical sentence pairs and calculating token-level bias attribution scores using information-theoretic measures.
